facts.fact: A Kenya Revenue Authority officer writing in WCO News says KRA's customs system matches scanned cargo to customs declarations and shares them through the EAC Single Customs Territory Centralized Platform, operational since July 2024.

A KRA officer writing in WCO News says the EAC Single Customs Territory Centralized Platform, built for Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania and South Sudan, has shared customs declarations and scanned-cargo images since July 2024, with Kenya sending over 20,000 images to Uganda.

A KRA officer writing in WCO News says Uganda Revenue Authority scans all cargo entering or leaving Uganda and matches it to customs declarations, sharing them through the EAC Single Customs Territory Centralized Platform since July 2024.

A KRA officer writing in WCO News says the EAC Single Customs Territory Centralized Platform, built for six partner states, has shared customs declarations and scanned-cargo images since July 2024, with Uganda sending over 8,000 images to Kenya.

KEN.note: Data centres are built by the revenue authority for its own use, not for hire.

UGA.note: Data centres are built by the revenue authority for its own use, not for hire.
The platform named is regional between EAC states, not a national government exchange.
No government interoperability framework is stated.
Only a customs image file format is named, not government standards.
